messages:
noah: trying to onboard a new VM with redwoodctl and hit a block: `apt install ./redwoodctl.deb` succeeds but `redwoodctl login` prints 'Waiting for authentication...' and never returns. headless Ubuntu 22.04. anyone seen pkexec hang like this?
tasha: yep, pkexec in package postinst will spawn a polkit GUI agent and block on headless. check `/var/lib/dpkg/info/redwoodctl.postinst` for pkexec usage.
noah: found it: `pkexec chown -R $SUDO_USER:$SUDO_USER /home/$SUDO_USER/.redwoodctl`. Workaround I used: `sudo mkdir -p ~/.redwoodctl ~/.local/share/redwoodctl && sudo chown $USER:$USER ~/.redwoodctl ~/.local/share/redwoodctl` then login works.
ben: thanks for the repro. Two bugs to file: 1) postinst calling pkexec unconditionally — should avoid polkit on headless (use runuser/sudo or create dirs as root then chown). 2) CLI credential fallback is slow when secret-service is unavailable; it waits ~20-30s before falling back to file-based store which causes profile switch/login to appear hung.
tasha: agreed. In CI we either install a console polkit agent (heavy) or patch packaging. Also add a fast (<2s) secret-service probe and immediate fallback in the CLI so CI doesn't time out.
noah: after the mkdir/chown workaround I still saw `profile switch` hang ~25s then `auth retry required` -> `rpc: connection reset`. strace showed it trying keyring paths and then failing to create `~/.local/share/redwoodctl/credentials.json` due to EACCES until I chowned that file.
ben: that suggests packaging might create files with wrong ownership/labels or postinst left mixed perms. Packagers should avoid pre-creating per-user files. We'll patch postinst and add a CLI improvement to surface permission errors (hint about chown/SELinux) instead of retrying blindly.
ci-bot: opened issue #4542: "headless postinst pkexec blocks installs; slow credential-store fallback and opaque perm errors causing login/profile hangs" assigned to @ben.
noah: thanks — workaround documented in onboarding notes. happy to test patches when available. :thumbsup:
